name: fogbugz-mcp
description: FogBugz MCP Server for interacting with FogBugz via LLMs

FOGBUGZ_URL.description: The URL of your FogBugz instance

R2_ACCOUNT_ID.description: Cloudflare account id for wiki upload staging (optional)

R2_BUCKET.description: R2 bucket for staged wiki uploads (optional)

R2_ACCESS_KEY_ID.description: R2 access key id with Object Read & Write on R2_BUCKET (optional)

tools.description: Provides tools for interacting with FogBugz issue tracking system
